_doc: V4-ICON-001 (Pass B V101 §9/§14) coverage manifest. GLYPHS must be a superset of EVERY array below; a missing key fails iconRegistryV101.test.js. The §9 coverage families are now enumerated key-by-key so a family that was SPECIFIED but never DRAWN is a red test rather than an invisible gap — the failure mode that let the action/care-state/facet families sit undrawn while the harness reported green over 8 anchors. Adding an array here is all it takes to guard a new family; the test iterates every array-valued property. The event.* family is deliberately NOT listed: iconEvents.test.js already gates it against the canonical EVENT_TYPES list, which is a stronger check than a hand-copied roster.
